en: Black-and-white photograph showing a quiet rural road bordered by trees on the left and fenced grassy yards with wooden houses on the right. The nearest house is a two-story light-colored building with a tiled roof and chimneys, standing on a small slope above a smaller outbuilding. Further along the road are more houses among trees and telephone poles. In the lower left corner, small white text reads "Eds Bruk."
